comment: The sculpted shape and the sound are separate: the six sculpting controls and the wander knob move a shape that only the display draws, and the output reads the stored table. Until a snap has been taken the table is empty and the module makes no sound at all (wave.cpp:17). The table is a first-in first-out ring of eight, and the scan position wraps continuously from the newest back to the oldest.
